_comment: Pinned program for the OUT-OF-BOUNDS query 'Does #23 score the goal?' on bernabeu-counter. Same chain as the #7 program but filters on a value NOT present in the cache (text == 23). The filter matches nobody -> empty subject -> even though a first goal exists, op_answer grounds out HONESTLY (grounded=false, reason='no-grounded-answer') rather than fabricating a 'No' about a player it never located (the honesty path proven in test_generalized_answer.py). Window widened to 9000-14800ms @ fps8 to match the #7 program (CONTAINS the real goal moment ~14250ms; the committed cache's event ts (10500) is a fake-fixture value and is wrong, though still inside this window). detect.on_pitch:true drops the off-pitch box (p4, bottom .25). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
